name: The Ridge RV Park
note: Grass back-in sites that can be muddy after rain, and no office: pick a site on arrival. A summer 2026 camper found the other RVs to be work crews. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: 2026-11-12: operator site ridgervcamp.com (live, (c) 2023, Wix) lists 17 full-hookup RV sites with 30/50 A, 'DAILY $40', weekly/monthly on request, tent sites $20, phone 701-401-1034, Book Now -> Campspot. Campspot (park 1458, legal name The Ridge RV Park LLC, 14410 85th Street SW) sells one night on all 17 'Deluxe Full Hookup RV Site' sites (Motorhome allowed, rig max 50 ft, back-in): Tue 2026-11-17 one night = $40.00 site + $2.00 'Campground Fees' (once per stay: 2 nights = $82) = $42 before tax, 17/17 free; 2026-12-15 and 2026-12-30 also 17/17 free; no minimum-stay rule. Price gate passes ($40 base, $42 with the per-stay fee; gateways.py not needed). Presence: working website + phone and an active booking site; Google Maps 'The Ridge RV Park' open, 4.4 from 18 reviews, same phone. Campspot reviews 4.3 from 7 ratings, dated September 2024-August 2026, all overnight/short-stay travellers ('A good place for a stopover', 'We spent two nights'). ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025): THE RIDGE RV CAMP LLC, 14410 85th ST SW, Bowman, 17 lots, licensed through 12/31/2025. Long-stay: every one of the 17 sites is sold by the night online (100% nightly, test 4 passes without caveat); no application, lease, waitlist, home sales or 2+ night minimum. Workforce: one August 2026 review says the other RVs that day 'were work campers', but the operator markets daily stays first and sells all lots nightly; not a workforce park (flagged). Not on RV Life (Algolia 5 km radius: only Twin Butte, Butte View, Bowman Lions) or in the Good Sam directory; admitted on the OSM-only bar (active booking site, published price, phone, Google 4.4). No horse, 4WD or rig-length restriction; gravel loop off a county road 150 m from US 85. SEPARATE from 5931 Twin Butte Campground: different HHS licence row (TWIN BUTTE CAMPGROUND, 14423 85th ST SW, different licensee, 15 lots), different operator, phones (701-523-5569/-2311/-0694), website, payment (cash/check only vs card/Venmo/Campspot) and facilities (Twin Butte has restrooms and showers, The Ridge none); The Ridge's RV field lies north of 85th St SW, Twin Butte's place south of it.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery frames at 46.1914,-103.3737 (300 m and 1400 m wide) and 46.1920,-103.3718 (220 m wide), all rendered: grass RV field between 85th St SW and US 85 among farm fields and windbreaks; no lake, river or pond anywhere in the 1.4 km frame. Not waterfront.

curation_note: ND lead 24 (2026-11-12): vetted as a separate park from 5931 Twin Butte (see inclusion_evidence). flags: Separate from 5931 Twin Butte Campground (separate_from given: pins ~0.2 km apart). No corrections to 5931 arise from this lead.

Workforce: one Campspot review (August 2026) says the other RVs that day were 'work campers'; all other dated reviews (2024-2026) are travellers, and all 17 sites are sold nightly online. Kept, with the work-crew line in the note.
Not on RV Life or Good Sam (the 'red flag' bar): admitted on an active Campspot booking page, published $40 rate, phone and Google 4.4/18.
Grass sites, muddy after rain and not all level (Campspot reviews 2025-09 and 2026-08).
Pin moved from the Google/Campspot point 46.19134,-103.37372 (on 85th St SW at the entrance) to the RV field centre 46.1918,-103.3717 (~160 m NE).
Elevation from USGS NED (opentopodata), not Open-Meteo: the Open-Meteo elevation API timed out twice.
